name: REV 13th Apostle | REV Trzynasty apostoł
source:
You wake up in a dimension beyond time and space, with no idea how you got there. A horned entity announces: "you are here because you have just died." All that's left for you is to relive the last month of your life, see what led to your death, and challenge a ruthless fate.

Set in a small seaside town in Poland, 13th Apostle is a dating simulator featuring a unique cast of characters, where each love interest has their own distinct personality and body type. Who you choose will lead to a wide variety of stories. These stories allow you to view the central mystery from different perspectives.

From: https://megobari.itch.io/rev-13th-apostle
